messages.subject: Facing Problem in Installing Shiny Server
parts:
Hi,

I have successfully installed the Node.js, R-3.0.0 and Shiny in R. I tried executing the command "npm install -g shiny-server" run as a root to install the Shiny Server, but i am getting the error below:-

npm http GET https://registry.npmjs.org/shiny-server
npm http GET https://registry.npmjs.org/shiny-server
npm http GET https://registry.npmjs.org/shiny-server
npm ERR! Error: connect ETIMEDOUT
npm ERR!     at errnoException (net.js:884:11)
npm ERR!     at Object.afterConnect [as oncomplete] (net.js:875:19)
npm ERR! If you need help, you may report this log at:
npm ERR!     <http://github.com/isaacs/npm/issues>
npm ERR! or email it to:
npm ERR!     <np...@googlegroups.com>

npm ERR! System Linux 2.6.32-279.el6.x86_64
npm ERR! command "/usr/local/bin/node" "/usr/local/bin/npm" "install" "-g" "shiny-server"
npm ERR! cwd /root/rdownload/R_Shiny/R-3.0.0/bin/exec
npm ERR! node -v v0.10.6
npm ERR! npm -v 1.2.18
npm ERR! syscall connect
npm ERR! code ETIMEDOUT
npm ERR! errno ETIMEDOUT
npm ERR!
npm ERR! Additional logging details can be found in:
npm ERR!     /root/rdownload/R_Shiny/R-3.0.0/bin/exec/npm-debug.log
npm ERR! not ok code 0

Could someone please suggest solution to install the shiny server in my Linux machine.

Thanks in advance,
Tushar
